notices.short_title: Designation
notices.description:
November 9, 2026

 

I hereby designate New York City Tourism + Conventions as the designated agency pursuant to and for the purposes of section 3-119.13 of the Administrative Code of the City of New York as enacted by Local Law 110 of 2026, a Local Law in relation to requiring a designated agency to develop and implement a cultural passport program encouraging visitation to participating sites in each borough.

I further designate the Department of Records and Information Services as the designated agency pursuant to and for the purposes of subdivision c of section 25-102.2 of the Administrative Code of the City of New York as enacted by Local Law 122 of 2026, a Local Law in relation to the online publication of new biographical information relating to past local laws that changed the name of streets or parks.
notices.plain: The Office of the Mayor designated New York City Tourism + Conventions to develop a cultural passport program encouraging visits to participating sites in each borough, and the Department of Records and Information Services to publish online biographical information about past laws that renamed streets or parks, both under Local Laws 110 and 122 of 2026.
